complex: Delta_X = finite prime subsets S with product(S)<=X, empty face included; augmented degree |S|-1
best_unmatched_bound_scope: Total residual count of the explicit topology-preserving matching, not the signed Mertens sum or all possible nonlocal pairings
chain_decomposition: b_n=[2,sigma_n], z_n=boundary(b_n), boundary b_n=z_n, boundary z_n=0; n odd squarefree

large_prime_parent_counterexample: X=5: singleton faces 3 and 5 both map to the empty face 1
recursive_identity: Delta_X = D_p(X) union p*D_p(X/p), where D_p excludes prime p
local_to_global_obstruction: Overlapping divisor simplexes and shared parents create multiplicities, not new cancellation estimates
